Accurately states the overall tradeoff and characterizes fixed descriptions as cheap, reliable, and insensitive to the current query.
Accurately preserves the comparison: fixed pointers are cheap and dependable, query-time pointers gain query-specificity, and crafted phrases provide the densest characterization.
Faithfully captures all three pointer classes and their relevant tradeoffs, including crafted phrases’ dependence on authors supplying them.
